title: Survival Armorstand Arms
description: Throw a stick to any armor stand to enabla arms! Useful for survival decorating.
body:
Introducing Survival Armorstand Arms! Elevate your Minecraft experience with this unique datapack that adds a touch of interactivity to your armor stands. With a simple toss of a stick, watch as your armor stand comes to life, showing its arms in response.

### How to use

1. Install the datapack. No other installations are required. [How to install a datapack](https://minecraft.fandom.com/wiki/Tutorials/Installing_a_data_pack)
2. Place in survival mode an armor stand (or any other gamemode!).
3. **Throw a stick** to the armor stand (*Don't throw more than one at the same time*)
4. The armorstand will **show it's arms**! Now, you can store swords in them, or use them as decoration in survival!
